targetText: The capitalistic system of production not only dominates the social organization but also the political organization.
summary: Bebel traces the relentless concentration and centralization of capital, as large-scale mechanized industry crushes small artisans and handicrafts, creating a growing reserve army of labor and concentrating immense wealth in trusts and cartels.
